يتفاجأ (form VI)
# يَتَفَاجَأُ (yatafājaʔu) /ja.ta.faː.d͡ʒa.ʔu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of تَفَاجَأَ (tafājaʔa)
# يُتَفَاجَأُ (yutafājaʔu) /ju.ta.faː.d͡ʒa.ʔu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of تَفَاجَأَ (tafājaʔa)
# يَتَفَاجَأَ (yatafājaʔa) /ja.ta.faː.d͡ʒa.ʔa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of تَفَاجَأَ
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
